description: The Bureau registry analysis: who registered the ERC-8004 ids on Robinhood Chain. Totals, how many ids sit with owners holding 20 or more (registration factories), the largest owners with the kind of wallet, first and last registration day and the web hosts in their registration files, and same-code factory families. Pass host (a web host such as example.com) to count the ids whose registration files point there, or wallet to check one address: ids it holds now, contract or plain wallet, and its row when it is a large owner. Counts registrations, never agents doing work. Plain wallets are shown only as a hash. Read only, free.

host.description: Optional web host to count, for example example.com.

name: bureau_registry
